lines.tts: Last night, Thai-land floated lamps... for Ganga.

caps: They call her | *PHRA MAE KHONGKHA.* | *MOTHER GANGA.*
lines.tts: They call her, Prah Meh Kongkaa... Mother Ganga.

caps: The *SAME* night, | *KASHI* lit its ghats | for the gods.
lines.tts: The same night, Kashi lit its घाट for the gods.
Two thousand kilometres apart. Same night. Same moon.

caps: Thailand's own king, *RAMA IV,* | wrote that this festival | began as a *HINDU* one.
lines.tts: Coincidence? Thailand's own king, Rama the Fourth, wrote that this festival began as a Hindu one.

caps: On this full moon, | *ODISHA* still floats | tiny lamp *BOATS*…
for its old sailors, | who sailed to | *BALI* and *JAVA.*
lines.tts: On this full moon, Odisha still floats tiny lamp boats... for its old sailors, who sailed to Bali and Java.

caps: They carried a *SCRIPT:* | Thailand's first letter | comes from our *KA.*
lines.tts: They carried a script. The first letter of the Thai alphabet... comes from our letter, क.
A city. Ayutthaya... named after अयोध्या.

caps: And songs: | Bangkok's royal priests | still chant *TAMIL* hymns | to *SHIVA.*
lines.tts: And songs. Bangkok's royal priests still chant Tamil hymns, to Shiva.

caps: So last night, | under *ONE* full moon…
lines.tts: So last night, under one full moon... one old family... lit the same lamp.

caps: Where did *YOU* | light yours? | Comment your *CITY.*
lines.tts: Where did you light yours? Comment your city.
